source_fact.source_semantics: Use crumbly rice as garnish; soup may be prepared without rice.

producer_candidates.name: Рис отварной
producer_candidates.process_observation: Rice is boiled in salted water, drained/rinsed, then mixed with fat and heated.

producer_candidates.name: Рис припущенный
producer_candidates.process_observation: Half of the recipe fat goes into the liquid before rice; the rest is added to cooked rice.

reasons: Recipe 267 gives 20 g raw rice as a garnish input but does not identify a numbered garnish producer or an exact cooked garnish output mass.

Recipes 747/748 are published batch recipes with their own added fat (and salt/liquid process). Binding either one without an explicit source link can double-count or reallocate the 20 g butter already present in recipe 267.
The accepted Assembly-A policy does not authorize proportional scaling from a published institutional batch to a 20 g raw-rice child producer merely because a ratio can be calculated.
Raw rice nutrition therefore cannot be re-labelled as cooked garnish nutrition.
allowed_future_shape: A versioned producer/transformation binding may be introduced only after the exact child process, added-fat allocation, input/output mass state and applicable scaling authority are established.
